verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. The only evidence on it is a probe reporting that robots.txt on the taxapps.floridarevenue.com host returns 404, and nothing shows a robots.txt on the main floridarevenue.com domain. The llms.txt 404 probe concerns a different file and is not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
